posts.t: Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen in the starter’s net for the Sabres optional morning skate in Washington.

Luukkonen spoke with some of us post practice and we informed of what was going on with Hellebuyck. With that and his own play of late, focus is all he can do.

"Nobody is going to trust you more than yourself. People can say what they want. If it's good, if it's bad, it doesn't matter."
Flyers ice the puck with 2:30 left. Sabres pull Luukkonen for the extra attacker.
Cole Knuble gets another goal to put the Flyers up 3-1. That's a brutal goal for Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen to allow there.

Shot from the circle stopped by Luukkonen but the rebound pops out to Trevor Zegras who bangs it in out of the air to make it 2-0 Philly.

The Sabres can now be activated because they're down by two
Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen leads the Sabres out for warmup. Dan Vladar leads the way for the Flyers.
A well-attended optional morning skate for the Sabres is under way. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen is in the starter’s net.
Texier scores to put the Canadiens up 3-1 on the Sabres. Got a rebound in front and beat Luukkonen.
Cole Caufield scores to put the Canadiens up 2-1. The puck was sitting behind the net and Slafkovsky poked it away from Zellweger right to Caufield, who ripped it by Luukkonen.
